explanation: The printf function in C is used to produce formatted output to the standard output device, typically the console. It allows programmers to display text, variables, and other data in a structured way, making it essential for debugging, user interaction, and program results presentation.
example_explanation: This example demonstrates the printf function by outputting the string 'Hello, World!' to the console, showing how it sends text to the standard output device when the program runs.

extraction_metadata.source: The C Programming Language - Kernighan & Ritchie

keywords: printf, C formatted output, stdout, C print function
